name: toxzen
description: AI-shielded ban appeal processor that protects moderators from toxic content while helping them make faster, fairer decisions.

items.label: Submit Ban Appeal
items.description: Submit an appeal for your ban in this community.

items.label: Open ToxZen Queue
items.description: View and process pending ban appeals with AI-shielded summaries.

autoUnbanOnAccept.label: Automatically unban user on Accept verdict

denyResponseTemplate.label: Default denial response template
denyResponseTemplate.defaultValue: Thank you for your appeal, u/{username}. After careful review by our moderation team, your ban from r/{subreddit} has been upheld. You may submit another appeal in 30 days.

acceptResponseTemplate.label: Default acceptance response template
acceptResponseTemplate.defaultValue: Great news, u/{username}! After reviewing your appeal, we've decided to lift your ban from r/{subreddit}. Please review our community guidelines before posting again. Welcome back!

escalateResponseTemplate.label: Default escalation response template
escalateResponseTemplate.defaultValue: Your appeal has been escalated to senior moderators for r/{subreddit}. We will review the details and notify you once a final decision has been made.
